## Current Facts

- Sulayman Bowles is a UT Austin McCombs student and builder of Atlas.
- He founded Void Agency in December 2025. The agency reports $50K+ in collected client revenue as of May 2026.
- He is currently an AI Product Manager Intern at Chegg for May-August 2026.
- Atlas SEO Audit Console is a technical SEO crawl, evidence, indexation, link-analysis, and reporting system.
- Earlier Golden Hornet and UT Butler pages document a classical bass and composition background; those are historical sources, not current employment records.
